 pickup inspection steps I3, which must be carried out every 5000 km.

The car technical data:
 Type: Isusu Car Pickup, No. of Engine: 432, 
 Chassis : 7156784 , 
 Wight : I,46 Ton

The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Alaa Eldin, tested by eng. Aiman Mohamed Shabana, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by 
 general director eng. Mohamed Nageb and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head 
 Sector of Talkha PS

items:
Check front disc 
 brake pads and discs.

Check rear brake 
 lining and dram wear.

Check that the 
 fan belt gives a deflection 
 10 mm when the middle part of the beltis depressed with a force of 10 kg.

Check that the 
 brake and clutch fluid level

Check clutch 
 paddle free play and height 
 a) Free play 5 to 15 mm, b) Height 178 to 188 mm

Check brake pedal 
 free , height and allowance 
 a) Free play 6 to 10 mm, b) Height 174 to 184mm, 
 c) Allowance 75 mm

Check the battery 
 and apply thin coat of grease into the battery terminals to prevent corrosion

Check inflation 
 pressure for tires: - Front 28 psi, - Rear 60 psi

text:
Introduction
This document outlines the Isusu car 
 pickup inspection steps I3, which must be carried out every 5000 km.
The car technical data:
 Type: Isusu Car Pickup, No. of Engine: 432, 
 Chassis : 7156784 , 
 Wight : I,46 Ton
The first draft 
 initiated by eng. Mohamed Alaa Eldin, tested by eng. Aiman Mohamed Shabana, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abdel Gilel, accepted by 
 general director eng. Mohamed Nageb and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam Head 
 Sector of Talkha PS
Safety 
Precaution
Safety Belt must be on.
Fire Chimney mast be on.
Jake for tires.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set .
Cleaning fluid, Jake for tires,
Rag wipe, screw drivers.
Work to be Carried out
Change oil filter
Check front disc 
 brake pads and discs.
Check rear brake 
 lining and dram wear.
Check that the 
 fan belt gives a deflection 
 10 mm when the middle part of the beltis depressed with a force of 10 kg.
Check that the 
 brake and clutch fluid level
Check clutch 
 paddle free play and height 
 a) Free play 5 to 15 mm, b) Height 178 to 188 mm
Check brake pedal 
 free , height and allowance 
 a) Free play 6 to 10 mm, b) Height 174 to 184mm, 
 c) Allowance 75 mm
Check the battery 
 and apply thin coat of grease into the battery terminals to prevent corrosion
Clean 
 turbo charger.
Check inflation 
 pressure for tires: - Front 28 psi, - Rear 60 psi
Clean nozzles.
